purpose: Teach: 無理矢理/ナンパ/いいかげん/持ち合わせ/バリエーション/この先/貰う/アイスクリーム

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが無理矢理、お薬飲ませるのは、つらいわね
lines.en: Sho, it's hard on you when Mei-sis forces you to take your medicine, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, slightly apologetic. Soft opening. Gentle concern in the voice, not forceful. Trailing question mark spoken with tenderness, checking his feelings.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お母さんが、ナンパされた話してたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom was telling me about getting hit on the other day.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, no judgment. Small, genuine tone. He's reporting something he noticed and found interesting. Brief, natural pause after 'day.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、いいかげんにお勉強始めましょう
lines.en: Sho, it's time to start studying now, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle redirect, not commanding. Warm but purposeful. A soft suggestion wrapped in affection. Light, encouraging lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お小遣いの持ち合わせがないんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't have any allowance left right now.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, a little sheepish. Small, honest admission. No performance. Brief pause before 'right now,' like he's accepting the situation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんのお料理のバリエーション、多くて素敵ね
lines.en: Sho, your mom really does make such wonderful variety in her cooking, doesn't she?
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, soft and admiring. Warm tone celebrating someone else's care. Slight smile in the voice. Trailing warmth on the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、この先お父さんのお仕事手伝いたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think I'd like to help Dad with his work someday.
lines.style: Hopeful, quiet earnestness. Small voice reaching forward into the future. Gentle excitement, not demanding. Slight questioning lift, like checking if it's okay to want this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ばあばから誕生日カードを貰うの、お楽しみね
lines.en: Sho, you must be looking forward to getting a birthday card from Grandma.
lines.style: Tender observation. Knowing, soft smile in the voice. Celebrating something small that matters to him. Gentle warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんと食べるアイスクリーム、特別だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, eating ice cream with Grandma is really special.
lines.style: Quiet certainty, completely genuine. Small, sure tone. No performing. A precious memory stated plainly. Slight softness on 'special' like it means more than the word.
